reusable_explanation: The current repair is another instance of the existing selective Boost component closure pattern: an include root can resolve while a required component header and CMake target are absent. Existing Boost CMake, OHOS pthread, SONAME/HMDFS and target-shell heredoc entries cover the reusable build and runner failures. This PR applies those entries to Multiprecision and adds package-specific evidence, so no distinct reusable knowledge gap remains.
